description: Work out running pace, finish time or distance, in kilometres or miles. Mode 'pace' needs distance and timeSeconds; mode 'time' needs distance and paceSeconds (seconds per unit); mode 'distance' needs timeSeconds and paceSeconds. Distance is in the chosen unit. Returns pace per km and per mile, speed in km/h and mph, distance and total time. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/running-pace-calculator/

distance.description: Distance in the chosen unit (needed for 'pace' and 'time' modes)

paceSeconds.description: Pace in seconds per unit (needed for 'time' and 'distance' modes)

timeSeconds.description: Total time in seconds (needed for 'pace' and 'distance' modes)

unit.description: Unit for distance and the given pace. Default 'km'

name: hopi_running_pace_calculator

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)

title: Running pace calculator
